answer_1.quote: Two generation tasks are used for evaluation: summarization and dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2), ROUGE-L (R-L) scores to evaluate the generations for summarization task ... For the dialogue generation task ... we choose to report PPL ... Following Rashkin et al. (2021), we use a state-of-the-art natural language interference (NLI) model ... to predict whether a response can be entailed ... We use factCC to evaluate the faithfulness for the Xsum
